rows.grounds: indeclinable temporal adverb indicating sequence after the action described in the previous verse
genitive dependent qualifying arghyaṃ as the oblation belonging to or associated with fire
ritual offering; direct object of samādāya
absolutive expressing prior action completed before the next implied step
bahuvrīhi or descriptive compound qualifying arghyaṃ/vyavasthitām; internal sandhi marked by +
past participle qualifying the oblation as set or arranged in that form
